name: What is the typical process for coordinating appliance installation during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for coordinating appliance installation during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process involves several steps: first, we review your appliance selections and their specifications; then, we schedule deliveries to align with project milestones. Utility rough-ins (electrical, plumbing, gas) are completed before the appliances arrive. Finally, our team coordinates professional installers to connect and test each appliance, often alongside cabinet and countertop installations. This sequential approach minimizes downtime and ensures a smooth workflow.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves reviewing appliance specs, scheduling deliveries, completing utility rough-ins, and coordinating professional installation with other project milestones.
